title: Harmony Integration Demo — entropy + oracle blending → adjusted pace
abstract: Load beacons; compute dynamic centers, entropy; blend with oracle profiles; produce adjusted per-agent pace and reasons.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.aggregator import load_beacons, advise_all, compute_trends
from meta.sas.nominals import compute_centers
from meta.sas.entropy import compute_per_agent_entropy
from meta.sas.oracle import load_profiles, blend_priors
from meta.sas.harmony import compute_adjusted_pace

recs = load_beacons('storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons')
advice = advise_all()
trends = compute_trends()
centers = compute_centers(recs, window=None, min_samples=1)
entropy = compute_per_agent_entropy(recs, advice, trends, dynamic_centers=centers, window=10)

profiles = load_profiles('storage/shared/meta/sas/oracle_profiles')

rows = []
for agent, ent in entropy.items():
    # last known band/pace/entropy
    band = ent.get('band', 'Clean')
    base_pace = ent.get('pace', 0.0)
    H = ent.get('entropy', 0.0)

    # blend priors
    c_agent = centers.get(agent, {"Clean":800.0,"Borderline":1500.0,"Active":2400.0})
    v_idx = trends.get(agent, {}).get('volatility_index', 0.0)
    c_blend, v_blend, pace_bias = blend_priors(agent, c_agent, v_idx, profiles)

    # adjust pace with harmony rule
    adj_pace = compute_adjusted_pace(band, base_pace, H, pace_bias)

    rows.append({
        "agent": agent,
        "band": band,
        "entropy": round(H, 3),
        "base_pace": round(float(base_pace), 3),
        "adjusted_pace": round(float(adj_pace), 3),
        "pace_bias": pace_bias,
        "centers": c_agent,
        "centers_blended": c_blend
    })

out = {"rows": rows, "notes": "Adjusted pace clamps to band target range; entropy reduces pace up to 50%; oracle pace_bias applies per band."}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
